title: Ar-Ra'uf: The Divine Name Given to a Human Being Exactly Once
excerpt: Ar-Ra'uf occurs eleven times. Ten name God; the eleventh names the Prophet, in a verse whose first clause is about your difficulty being heavy on him. And al-Jalalayn defines a tyrant as one who strikes without ra'fah.
seo_title: Ar-Ra'uf: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Ar-Ra'uf appears 11 times in the Quran, 10 of God and once of the Prophet (9:128). What ra'fah means, and why al-Jalalayn defines a tyrant by its absence.
